newsitem.title: INDIA: Israel's Degem in Indian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Degem in Indian joint venture.

text.p: Israel president Ezer Weizman on Friday launched Shogun Degem Ltd, a joint venture between Israeli's Degem Systems and India's Shogun group of companies.
"Shogun Degem will launch two premier educational products for the first time in India," the firm said in a statement.
It said Degem Systems is a world leader in technology training and educational systems. India's Shogun group has interests in films, media, chemicals and consumer products.
Weizman is in Bombay, India's financial capital, on the final leg of his India tour. He returns home on Saturday.
